quick_english: When the concept impresses in order, for entry into the just-told nature — then the contemplation-sequence preceded by true reason, true scripture, true teacher's instruction has use.

For by concept-strength alone beings mistake themselves bound; that misapprehension is the cause obstructing saṃsāra — so the counter-pair concept arises, tearing the saṃsāra-causing concept: the cause of prosperity.

Such a concept, having crossed all delimited-natured Śiva-to-end tattvas, is undelimited-consciousness-merely-formed — that is the supreme truth, the place of thing-ordering, the world's essence; by it he breathes the world — that am I, world-crossed, world-self am I.
This does not arise for the māyā-blind, since true-reason and rest are absent.
Viṣṇu-and-rest are limited in scripture by passion-tattva only, so even in higher vision they show no inclination toward it — therefore hostile to true-reason, scripture, teacher-instruction alone.
As said in Pārameśvara: all Viṣṇu-and-rest are colored by knowledge-passion.
They find not the supreme tattva, devoid of omniscient-knowledge.
Therefore those pierced by the firm Śāṃbhava-descent-of-power, having impressed the concept by order of true-scripture-and-rest, enter the supreme own-nature.

But then would the supreme tattva be concept-form? Not so: the concept's work is merely breaking dual-residence, fulfilled thereby; the supreme tattva is everywhere all-formed self-luminous — so no service or refutation for anyone from concept.
There for the one pierced by excessively firm descent, self-attained, true-reason arises by itself — he is called initiated by the goddesses.
For another, by scripture-order and the rest — with elaboration we will say in the revelation of power-descent.

But the task lies in determining the teacher's scripture, and in the arising of fitting concept born of the scripture-family chain: that chain of concepts is called true-reason; it is called contemplation also — by indistinctness, existing things are contemplated as non-existent made distinct, by which.

And here no other yoga-limb is directly the means apart from true-reason, light-form of pure-knowledge: of austerity-and-rest, restraint-class, nonviolence-and-rest, yama-type, retention-and-rest, breath-restraint-class — what task in consciousness by being established in the knowable merely?

Withdrawal too should make the instrument-level excellent; meditation, concentration and samādhi too, performed successively by practice-order, should impart identity-with-meditated-object to the meditator.
But practice in supreme-tattva, in Siva-self, own-nature, is simply not possible.

For one rooted in consciousness, practice is the fixing of breath-mind-body — like bearing-load, scripture-knowing, dance-practice; but in consciousness-form nothing is to be taken, nothing removed — how then practice?
If asked 'by reasoning too?' — said: this is only the mode of removing dual-residence, nothing else.
Even in ordinary practice: manifesting the desired form of body-and-rest as consciousness-selfhood, and contemplating other-forms' absence — that is practice's purpose.
But in supreme tattva nothing is to be discarded, it is said.
Dual-residence too is not a separate thing-existing at all: it is mere own-nature-manifestation — so rejection-of-duality is done by concept, from the saying.

This supreme truth, own-nature, shining, manifestation-form-nature, taken by itself from autonomy — thrown off, turned-to-expansion, expanding, expanded: by this order it shines; and shining is the Supreme Lord's own nature too — so yoga-limbs are not directly the means here.

Reason may favor it, but true-reason alone is directly the means there; it is pure-knowledge too, and is impressed in many forms: offering, fire-offering, recitation, vow, yoga — therein all states' abode is the Supreme Lord alone, nothing separate exists; for establishing concept-conviction, the Supreme Lord alone is the offering-of-all-states: that is yāga; from heart-nature, for those who themselves show consciousness-entry, the offering in the Lord is easy — hence external use of flower, satisfaction, scent and rest was said.

All states are made of Supreme-Lord-light: for attaining the convinced concept, in the Supreme-consciousness-fire-light, in the desire to swallow all states — sudden becoming mere light-residue, dissolution of all states: fire-offering.

Likewise, for the arising of both-natured contemplation, by disregard alone of states divided by outer-inner-knowable forms: this supreme tattva is own-nature-formed — inner contemplation: recitation.
Everywhere always, for gaining impersonal Supreme-Lord-identification, by identification with equality to the Lord: viewing even the body, even pot-and-rest: vow.
As said in Śrī-Nandiśikhā: all-equality is the supreme vow.

Thus by various pure-knowledge-portion-formed concepts, what concept-independent natural supreme-truth-tattva shines — for establishment in being merely eternal-such-shining, the concept specific to own-nature-tracking: yoga.

Therein the Supreme-Lord, full-consciousness-natured — fullness his power, clan, capability, wave, heart, essence, pulsation, glory, triad, Kālī, Karṣaṇī, Caṇḍī, Vāṇī, enjoyment, vision, Nityā and rest — is denoted by scripture-languages running according to each sense; by that, by that form, in the hearts of meditators let it be.
She, by seeing whole-power-nature, shines as fullness-consciousness.
And his powers are countless.
Why say more? The world — those are his powers; how can they be taught?
In three the world is completed: by which this bears, sees, illumines up to Śiva-bearer-limit as mere uncaricatured-consciousness-form — the Supreme Lord; that is his Śrīparā-power.
By which, like mirror-elephant and rest, by difference-undifference: that is his Śrīparāparā-power.
By which, by self-distinct-from-each-other, by difference alone: that is his Śrīmadaparā-power.
The threefold holding of this, in self, by embracing, by tracking-nature, grasps: she is the Goddess Śrīparā herself, named by other words such as Śrīmat-mātṛ-sat-bhāva-kāla-karṣiṇī.
These four powers, from autonomy, each operate threefold alone.
In creation, preservation and dissolution — twelve they become.

Thus consciousness first constructs the state within; then outside too by distinctness; taking reddened-nature right there; then intends to reabsorb that state within; then forms the doubt obstacle-to-reabsorption and grasps it; the doubt-grasped portion, state-portion, he constructs in self by reabsorption; then constructs even my-this-form reabsorber-nature as own-nature; then in constructing reabsorber-nature, some state's standing by habit-nature, some's consciousness-merely-residue-nature; then by being inseparable from own-nature-constructing, the instrument-wheel; then even the instrument-Lord; then the constructed māyic knower-form; then the knower contraction-release-turned-expansion-grasp-taste-bearing; therefore even expanded form he constructs — thus these twelve Goddess-consciousnesses, targeting knower-objects one or even, simultaneously or in order, two-wise, three-wise, even-standing, arising-portioned, revolving like-wheel, outside too by order of month-segment-asterism-and-rest, within too by order of pot-cloth-and-rest, shining, nourishing the wheel-Lord's autonomy, denoted-by-Śrīkālī-word.
And construction is motion, throw, knowledge, counting, enjoyment-making, sound, self-dissolving too.
As the Śrībhūtirāja-teachers say: from throw and from knowledge Kālī, by subjection to construction then.
And this meaning is to be considered, spread here and there in my composed commentary, in treatise-hymn-and-rest.
Not too-secret to be shown somewhere, nor to be hidden in any way — so our teachers.
Thus what was said: offering, fire-offering and rest — in this kind the Great-Lord alone is to be thought.

All see Viṣṇu-to-Siva as to-be-rejected only, ground-form of to-be-accepted, by Parameśvara-nature; and that false-view is necessarily abandoned by unsurpassable-yogins — for that very sake the knowledge-Lord's great fervour in the hymn-of-experience: in this kind, in offering-and-rest, at yoga-end, in the fivefold, each many-form establishment; as it becomes, so let him practise — not by discrimination of edible-inedible-clean-unclean-and-rest, by abandoning thing-qualities, by fancy-merely-essence tormenting own-self — so said in Śrīpūrva-and-rest. For purity is not a thing's form like blueness elsewhere, from command-of-impurity on it; like gift's command in initiation — if 'that is impure there' by another command too the same, other-command not-existing from being-overridden — if not, Siva's-command's obstructive-power alone is established-by-reason, established by omniscient-unsurpassable-endless-scripture too — we will say.
Therefore from Vedic on, spoken in Pārameśvara-system-tantra-clan-Ucchuṣma-and-rest-scripture too, whatever restraint or injunction or prohibition — here it is established of no effect whatsoever.
Likewise said in Śrīpūrva-and-rest, spread — from Tantrāloka to be sought.
